name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall on the floor with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing inward.
Keep your knees soft and press through the balls of both feet to lift your heels.
Pause briefly at the top while squeezing your calves tightly.
Lower your heels smoothly back down to the floor before starting the next repetition.
tips: Press evenly through the big-toe and pinky-toe sides of your feet so your ankles do not roll outward.
Avoid bouncing quickly at the bottom or bending your knees to assist the lift.
